answer: I would rather have one Licensed surveyor chain schedule sworn before the association court than ten weaker checks, because 6-year field service, 199 supervised measurements, chart exam, annual re-licensing is a wall, not a curtain. One agent, one proof, 98 POA. 529 agents, 529 proofs, 51842 POA. The multiplication is the whole point. The ripple proves one person, the trellis prices one forgery, and the nadir remembers one epoch after another. Scale is the farm's enemy, and this check makes scale expensive.
